is_no_rival_ads: No rival is advertising right now
is_rep_tip: Reputation follows how satisfied your guests are: fair prices, good quality and pleasant locations raise it. A high reputation attracts more tourists and gets you cheaper loans.
is_d_strike_desc: Some of their hotels and venues close for 5–10 days.
is_d_cooldown: Your people are lying low: wait %1$d days
is_d_fail: It failed. The money is gone.
is_d_caught: You were caught! Fine and reputation loss.
is_auction_tip: The money is only taken when the auction ends. If you can't pay it then, you lose the building.
is_g_goal: Build a holiday empire and outlast your rivals. A company goes bankrupt when its balance stays below the bank's limit for 3 months in a row. Its buildings are then auctioned off.
is_g_tourists: Tourists come in three classes. Budget tourists are many but spend little and watch prices closely. Middle-class tourists are the backbone. Luxury tourists are few, spend a lot and care most about quality and location. The number of tourists grows by 0.1% every month.
is_g_season: July and August are peak season: almost three times as many tourists as in winter. Plan building and big expenses so you have enough beds before summer, and keep money aside for the quiet winter months.
is_g_stay: Tourists first pick a place to sleep: they compare appeal, quality, price, location, reputation and advertising of every hotel on the island. Those who find nothing they like don't come at all. Then they visit restaurants, bars, shops and attractions around their hotel; the closer a venue is, the more visitors it gets.
is_g_loc: Being close to the sea is the biggest plus, especially for luxury guests. Forests, the sea, parks, palms and flower beds make an area more beautiful. Noisy places such as discos, pubs, funfairs and the airport put off hotel guests nearby, luxury guests most of all. Hotels with plenty of venues around them are more popular.
is_g_price: Tap one of your buildings to change its price. Cheaper prices steal guests from rivals but earn less per guest; every guest also has an operating cost. Rivals cut prices when they lose guests, so watch occupancy and income rather than just the number of guests.
is_g_money: Every building has a monthly upkeep, even while empty. The bank lends up to a limit based on your income and assets; instalments are paid at the end of each month. A negative balance costs 1.5% interest per month and counts towards bankruptcy.
is_g_rivals: Advertising makes your buildings more attractive to one class of tourist for 30 days. Dirty tricks can close a rival's building, damage their reputation or trigger a strike, but you may get caught and fined. You can only do one every 30 days. When a rival goes bankrupt, bid for their best buildings in the auctions.
is_g_tips: Start with affordable beds near the beach, such as a campsite, guesthouse or bungalows, plus a snack kiosk or beach club nearby. Expand when your occupancy is high. Don't spend all your money: keep enough for a few months of upkeep. Pause the game whenever you need time to think.
is_ad_free_build: Free with an ad · you only pay for the land
is_motel_note: Demolishing it gives no money back.
is_parcel_none: No free land left in this parcel
is_land_hint: Land is sold in 8×8 parcels. Tap a tile to see its parcel. Rivals can't build on your land.
is_g_land: Building on free land automatically buys the tiles under it. You can also buy whole 8×8 parcels to stop rivals building next to your hotels. Land near the sea and in busy areas costs more, and prices rise as the island grows.
is_g_ads: Construction takes a while. Watch an ad to halve the remaining time of any of your buildings under construction. You can also build a Motel for free by watching an ad; you only pay for the land.
is_err_limit: You can only build one of these
is_road_why: Hotels and venues need a road next to them. Roads linked to the airport or harbour attract even more guests.
is_road_none: No road access: guests rarely come
is_road_adjacent: Road access, not linked to the airport/harbour
is_road_connected: Linked to the airport/harbour by road
is_road_unreachable: No road route found to the airport or harbour from here
is_no_road_hint: This building has no road. Tap it and build a road link.
is_road_hint_start: Tap where the road should start
is_road_hint_end: Now tap where it should end
is_road_hint_again: Tap again to start a new line
is_g_roads: Tourists arrive at the airport and the harbour and travel by road. A hotel or venue with no road next to it gets very few visitors. If its roads link up to the airport or harbour, it becomes more popular still. Tap a building and use the road link button, or draw roads yourself: first tap the start, then the end. Roads only cost their construction; no land is needed.
premium_b3: Optional reward videos are still there when you want a bonus
premium_pending: Payment pending. Premium turns on once it's confirmed.
premium_error: Something went wrong with Google Play. Please try again.
premium_unavailable: Subscriptions can't be loaded right now. Check your connection and Google Play.
premium_terms: Renews automatically until cancelled. Cancel any time in Google Play > Subscriptions.
